description: This file defines a SwiftUI view component 'TalkOverlayView' with associated auxiliary views and classes for a talk overlay UI element in a macOS app. It includes gesture handling, custom drawing, and interaction logic.

classes.name: OrbInteractionNSView
classes.description: A custom NSView handling mouse interactions (click, drag, double click) for orbital control.

methods.name: makeNSView
methods.description: Creates and configures a custom NSView for interaction.

methods.name: updateNSView
methods.description: Updates the state of the NSView with new callback handlers.

methods.name: mouseDown
methods.description: Handles mouse down events, detects double clicks.

methods.name: mouseDragged
methods.description: Handles drag events, initiates dragging behavior.

methods.name: mouseUp
methods.description: Handles mouse release, determines if it was a click or drag.
